title: PageSpec
description: Declarative contract for one page. A PageSpec names a template and supplies section content; it never contains markup. Generators MUST validate against this schema and against contracts/composition.json before emitting a page.

pagespecVersion.description: Schema version this spec targets. Reject on mismatch rather than guessing.

route.description: URL path. Lowercase, hyphenated, no trailing slash.

template.description: Template id from registry/templates.json. Determines which sections are legal and in what order.

sections.description: Ordered sections. Order is validated against contracts/composition.json.

component.description: MUST appear in registry/allowlist.json. Any other value is a hard failure — generators may not invent components.

variant.description: MUST be listed under this component's variants in contracts/components.json.

id.description: Anchor id, when the section is a jump-nav target.

tint.description: Background token name. MUST resolve in tokens/tokens.json; raw hex is rejected.

content.description: Slot values. Keys and capacities are constrained per component in contracts/components.json.
